say.variants.default: Hard to picture what this county looked like before July. Where were you when things fell apart?
If we're watching each other's backs, I figure I ought to ask—where'd you come from before all this?
say.variants.positive: Feels good talking to someone who remembers normal life, {addressee.name}. What did you used to do around here?
Always wondered who else made it out of the towns nearby. Were you local to Knox County?
say.variants.neutral: Where were you at when the roadblocks went up?
You from around Muldraugh or West Point, or just caught passing through?
say.variants.negative: Folks out here don't talk much about who they used to be. Doesn't always end well.
I'm not prying—just wondering if you're from nearby or drifted in from outside the zone.
say.variants.contextual: Seeing these empty storefronts still throws me off. Did you have family or work out this way?
Sometimes the quiet hits harder than the sirens did. Who were you before the TVs went to static?
entries.reply.blocked.say.variants.default: Not the time for life stories.
entries.reply.blocked.say.variants.negative: Save it. Keep your eyes on the street.
entries.reply.shared.say.variants.default: Funny how fast a regular job turns into useless trivia, huh, {addressee.name}? Good knowing a bit about you.
entries.reply.shared.say.variants.positive: Feels good remembering we had real lives once, {addressee.name}. Appreciate you sharing that.
entries.reply.guarded.say.variants.default: Let's just say I worked with my hands and leave the rest behind.
entries.reply.guarded.say.variants.neutral: I lived quiet before, and I'd rather keep it that way now.
entries.reply.guarded.say.variants.contextual: Too many names I don't want to say out loud anymore. Maybe another night.
entries.reply.evasive.say.variants.default: Doesn't matter much what I did before. Only matters what keeps us alive today.
entries.reply.evasive.say.variants.neutral: Long story, and none of it puts food in a pack.
entries.reply.refused.say.variants.default: I'd rather not dig into all that.
entries.reply.refused.say.variants.negative: Drop it. My past is my own business.
entries.reply.reveal_source.say.variants.default: Alright, {addressee.name}—our old crew split near the rail yard, and that's where I got my rig.
entries.reply.protect_source.say.variants.defaul: Not giving names for folks who didn't ask to be dragged back into Knox County's mess.
entries.reply.withdraw.say.variants.default: Enough looking back. Past won't bar tonight's windows.
